description: get_keys(force=true) calls fetch_fresh_keys() which calls discover_jwks_uri() every time. On every forced refresh (key rotation event), the code issues TWO HTTP requests: one to /.well-known/openid-configuration and one to the jwks_uri. The discovery document URI is a stable OIDC convention; it will not change during the lifetime of the process. Caching the jwks_uri in ProviderValidator alongside the key cache would halve the HTTP round-trips on rotation events and eliminate the possibility that a flapping or slow discovery endpoint causes auth failures even when the JWKS endpoint itself is healthy.
title: oidc: JWKS fetch calls discover_jwks_uri on every force-refresh, even if URI is cached
